sources.employerName: Legislative Assembly of British Columbia staff
sources.title: Legislative Assembly administration staff compensation 2021/22
notes: Administration employee payments of $75,000 or greater only; excludes caucus and constituency office staff and elected MLAs.
Cash-basis total salary payments include salary, overtime and vacation payout, not an annual salary rate. Salary also includes taxable benefits and other salary-related payments.
Expenses are not disclosed and remain null. Names and positions are preserved as published; no cross-year identity inference.
Published row totals are retained unchanged. Small differences against the printed grand total are recorded as whole-dollar reporting residuals.
